event.title: FSFE booth at the Carinthian Linux Day 2026 in Villach, Österreich

body.p: The Carinthian Linux Day will be an afternoon and evening of Linux, FLOSS and digital sovereignty. There will be a keynote, talks, workshops, discussions and info booths. In particular also an FSFE info booth!
The event will be in German, free of charge, on October 30th 2026, from 15:00 in the "IT-Gymnasium St.Martin", St.Martiner Straße 7 in Villach, Austria.
